test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Harshi bought a new sweatshirt at the store, when they were giving a 40 percent discount. If the marked price of the sweatshirt was Rs. 2999, then how much did Harshi pay with the discount?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of the sweatshirt = Rs. 2999

Discount percentage = 40%

**Formula:**

Amount to be paid after discount = Marked price - (Discount percentage × Marked price)/100

**Solution:**

Substituting the given values into the formula:

2999 - (40/100) × 2999

2999 - (0.4) × 2999

2999 - 1199.6

Rs. 1799.40

**Therefore, Harshi paid Rs. 1799.40 after applying the 40% discount on the marked price.**
